# Manifest.eco

Manifest.eco offers direct-to-consumer fulfillment solutions, business-to-business fulfillment solutions, and ecommerce fulfillment solutions. They provide precision, care, and scalability to ensure brand success and ensure retail and marketplace connections fortified with unparalleled efficiency and expert support. Their mission is to transition ecommerce fulfillment to a new standard. Manifest.eco employs 29 people (+16.0% YoY, +4 people), founded in 2021. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, United States. Its workforce is distributed across United States, India, and Greece.

# Manifest Climate

Manifest Climate is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Manifest Climate is an AI-powered assessment platform that runs rigorous assessments across hundreds of entities in under an hour. Manifest Climate employs 28 people (-6.7% YoY, -2 people) and has an annual revenue of $4.5M, founded in 2015. Headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada, with presence in United States. Its workforce is distributed across Canada, India, and United States.

## About

The challenge isn't getting answers from AI. It's building the infrastructure that makes those answers rigorous, repeatable, and defensible.

Most teams use AI to generate insights, fast. Then they struggle: findings lack source citations. Results shift with every run. Peer comparison is impossible. Defensibility is an afterthought.

Manifest Climate is an AI-powered assessment engine built to solve this. We transform information into comparable, defensible, decision-ready findings, at scale. Every recommendation is source-cited. Every result is consistent. Every finding is auditable.

Advisory firms win more deals. Asset managers monitor portfolios with confidence. NGOs prove impact. Public companies benchmark against peers. What they all have in common: they need intelligence they can act on and stand behind.

No manual analysis. No setup required. Just hours to assess hundreds of entities with the rigor that critical decisions demand.

SOC 2 compliant. Built for teams that can't afford to get it wrong.
